facts.summary: Preliminary dose-escalation data disappointed versus expectations, with one pneumonitis death · Phase 1 · ERAS-0015 in RAS-mutant solid tumors · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Erasca, Inc. (the “Company”) announced positive preliminary Phase 1 dose escalation data for its potentially best-in-class, pan-RAS molecular glue ERAS-0015 in patients with RAS-mutant solid tumors.
evidence.safety: One Grade 3 TRAE of pneumonitis progressed to Grade 5 after withdrawal of supportive care per patient decision.
